RM cardiaca normale: anatomia e funzione: Normal cardiac MRI: anatomy and function on bSSFP cine (Stanford HV_005)
Uomo di 25 anni, volontario sano (1,70 m: 25-year-old man, healthy volunteer (1.70 m, 68 kg). 3 T cardiac MRI: bSSFP cine in 3 chambers, 4 radial long axes and a 12-slice short-axis stack (30 phases per cycle).
Riconosci le viste e le strutture; descr: Recognize the views and the structures; describe the wall motion and indicate how you would measure the ejection fraction.
Caso di riferimento normale. Le cine bSS:
Normal reference case. The bSSFP cine images show bright blood and dark myocardium with excellent contrast. The standard views: 4-chamber, 2-chamber, 3-chamber (outflow tract and aortic valve) and a short-axis stack from base to apex; here there are also radial long axes rotated by 36° around the ventricular axis.
The ejection fraction is calculated from the end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes obtained by summing the contoured areas on the short-axis stack (Simpson). Indicative normal values in adults: LV EF about 55-70%, end-diastolic thickness < 12 mm. In the report, segmental wall motion is described according to the 17-segment AHA model (“bull's eye” chart Σ).
RM cardiaca: FE e volumi dalla pila di a: Cardiac MRI: EF and volumes from the short-axis stack, not from a single view.
Volontario sano arruolato nello studio S: Healthy volunteer enrolled in the Stanford study (no known cardiac disease).
Come si misurano volumi e funzione?: How are volumes and function measured?
Ventricoli di dimensioni normali, con is: Ventricles of normal size, with uniform systolic thickening of all walls of the left ventricle and preserved biventricular function on visual assessment
Spessore parietale del ventricolo sinist: Normal left ventricular wall thickness (end-diastolic < 12 mm), without pericardial effusion
Tutte le pareti si ispessiscono in sisto: All walls thicken in systole: look at the short-axis stack in cine mode.
Ventricolo sinistro dilatato con funzion: Dilated left ventricle with reduced function
Volumi e frazione di eiezione si misuran: Volumes and ejection fraction are measured by contouring the endocardium on the short-axis stack at end-diastole and end-systole (Simpson method); mass by also contouring the epicardium
I valori si indicizzano per superficie c: Values are indexed to body surface area and compared with age- and sex-specific references
La frazione di eiezione si misura su una: The ejection fraction is measured on a single 4-chamber image
Il metodo su un solo piano assume una fo: The single-plane method assumes an ellipsoid shape of the ventricle: it is less accurate than the short-axis stack.
La cine 3 camere serve per misurare la m: The 3-chamber cine is used to measure mass
RM cardiaca nei limiti: dimensioni, spes: Cardiac MRI within normal limits: preserved dimensions, thicknesses and biventricular function
Asse corto medio-ventricolare (livello d: Mid-ventricular short axis (level of the papillary muscles)
La frazione di eiezione si misura su una: Ejection fraction is measured on a single 4-chamber image, with the area-length method
La cine 3 camere serve per misurare la m: The 3-chamber cine is used to measure left ventricular mass
Cardiomiopatia dilatativa con ventricolo: Dilated cardiomyopathy with an enlarged left ventricle and reduced ejection fraction
Cardiomiopatia ipertrofica con setto int: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with an interventricular septum thickened beyond 15 mm
